name: DAYANG
recent: 近期公告主要是雇员公积金局（EPF）和 Aberdeen 系基金的大股东权益变动申报，未见重大企业活动。新闻方面，公司被报道拥有 47 亿令吉订单，并预期在 FY27 复苏，同时寻求海外合约。最新季度（2026-06-30）营收和净利同比下滑，但环比改善。
notable: 新闻报导公司拥有 47 亿令吉订单，并预期 FY27 盈利复苏。
新闻报导公司寻求海外市场合约，CIMB Securities 认为新海外市场有上行空间。
最新季度营收和净利环比分别增长 21.8% 和 52.6%。
risks: 最新季度营收和净利同比分别下降 39.7% 和 57.2%。
近期有多笔大股东权益变动申报，涉及 EPF 和 Aberdeen 系基金。
earnings: 截至 2026-06-30 季度，营收为 1.6118 亿令吉，净利为 3284 万令吉，净利率 20.4%。营收环比增长 21.8%，净利环比增长 52.6%，但同比分别下降 39.7% 和 57.2%。

recent_en: Recent announcements are mainly changes in substantial shareholder interests by EPF and Aberdeen-related funds, with no major corporate activities. In the news, the company is reported to have a RM4.7 billion order book and is expected to recover in FY27 while seeking overseas contracts. The latest quarter (2026-06-30) saw revenue and net profit decline year-on-year but improve quarter-on-quarter.
notable_en: News reports the company has a RM4.7 billion order book and expects earnings recovery in FY27.
Latest quarter revenue and net profit grew 21.8% and 52.6% quarter-on-quarter, respectively.
risks_en: Latest quarter revenue and net profit declined 39.7% and 57.2% year-on-year, respectively.
There have been multiple changes in substantial shareholder interests involving EPF and Aberdeen-related funds.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 2026-06-30, revenue was RM161.18 million and net profit was RM32.84 million, with a net margin of 20.4%. Revenue grew 21.8% and net profit grew 52.6% quarter-on-quarter, but declined 39.7% and 57.2% year-on-year, respectively.
